title: Serving cadence: weekly playbook + action tracker (Kieran)
content:
Purpose: quick, focused weekly sync for serving runtime + infra + console owners. Single-slide objective: ensure no regressions in latency/cost after last deploy; unblock console rollout; triage any oncall escalations.

Meeting logistics:
- When: weekly, Monday 10:00–10:30 PT (timebox 30m)
- Attendees: eng-serving-runtime core leads, infra oncall, console PM/eng rep (Aisha), SRE liaison (Diego)
- Pre-reads (skim 5 min): JIRA-RT-4531 (fallback routing), PR#2145 (console rollout patch), latency heatmap (linked in Confluence-7892)

One-page objective (what success looks like):
- No >5% p50/p95 latency regressions vs baseline across public routes.
- Console rollout can proceed to Canary-2 (no blocking bugs).
- Action queue below down to 3 actionable tickets.

Top signals to surface (bring a single metric bullet):
- Production p95 tokens/ms for hosted-api route /v1/generate (last 24h vs baseline): +3%
- Error budget burn for dedicated pools: 0.6% this window (ok)
- Prefix cache hit-rate by model family (gpt-xx-like): 74% (target 80%) -> call out warmup plan

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick pulse (5m) — one sentence per owner: latency, infra capacity, console rollout
2) Console rollout checklist (8m) — Aisha: canary results, UX gating bug, metrics to validate (PR#2145)
3) Fallback policy smoke results (6m) — Samir: results of yesterday's simulated capacity drain (JIRA-RT-4531)
4) Prefix/KV cache warmup plan (5m) — Maya: staged warmup during low-traffic windows; experiment A/B
5) Parking lot & action-review (6m) — call out blockers, set owners + due dates

Preparation notes (Kieran scratchpad):
- Grab last 48h flamegraph from runtime-tracing for route /v1/chat; flag anything with increased allocation.
- Check kernel selection metrics: are we seeing a different kernel picked after the model patch? If yes, list which model/seq-length combos.
- On console metrics: verify tokenized request sampling rate for canary (should be at 5%) — confirm Aisha's sampling job ran.
- Oncall: remind Diego that Friday night handover requires a short doc in the oncall channel with top 3 risks.

Open questions (note to self):
- Do we need an automated rollback if prefix cache hit drops below 50% during rollout? (temp mitigation?)
- Can we relax batching window for a short period to reduce p95 while we warm cache? tradeoffs?

Action items (tracker — update status during meeting):
- RT-1: Finish e2e fallback smoke script and publish results (owner: Samir Patel, due: 2026-03-17, status: in_progress)
- RT-2: Increase prefix cache warmup window & schedule low-traffic warmup job (owner: Maya Gupta, due: 2026-03-15, status: open)
- RT-3: Console canary verification: add sampled token-level latency panel + alert if p95 increases >10% (owner: Aisha Chen, due: 2026-03-14, status: open, linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/2145)
- RT-4: Oncall handover checklist doc for Friday->Mon (owner: Diego Ramos, due: 2026-03-13, status: open)
- RT-5: Investigate kernel selection shift for model redwood-7b (owner: Kieran Lowe, due: 2026-03-18, status: open)

Parking lot (defer to infra sync or deep-dive):
- Explore predictive cache prewarming based on traffic seasonality windows (longer-term)
- Batching policy auto-tuner idea: meet with Research to scope (ask: Matteo/Arjun)

Notes to self / friction log (rough):
- Watch for noisy signal: small downstream retry storms artificially inflating p95; correlate with gateway logs.
- When pushing rollout, explicitly tag requests with canary-id for easier tracing.
- Keep list of small, quick wins vs high-effort tasks in the sprint backlog; we should be able to clear 2 quick wins each week.

Post-meeting follow-up template (to DM owners):
- "Quick follow-up from today's serving cadence: you own RT-2 (prefix warmup). Please paste planned job cron + brief rollback plan here by EOD. If blocked, ping me with the blocker and ETA."

Personal TODOs after meeting (Kieran):
- Draft rollback play snippet for prefix cache (short doc, add to Confluence-7892)
- Run local perf harness with kernel-selection flags and attach results to PR#2145
- Sync with Aisha re: sampling job verification tomorrow morning

Revision history:
- 2026-03-09: initial scratch draft
- 2026-03-11: added action tracker and linked PR
- 2026-03-13: updated dates, moved RT-4 due to oncall constraints

End of scratchpad. Keep this lightweight — transfer final action items to JIRA after meeting.
